title.narrative: ZAMBIA IRELAND SUSTAINABLE FOOD SYSTEMS STRENGTHENING

description.narrative: The overarching objective of the project is to ‘support a just transition towards sustainable food systems in Zambia through interventions in Climate Action, One Health and Policy Coherence, leading to increased resilience to climate, environmental, production and consumption shocks and crisis risk reduction’.With the following specific objectives:1. Climate Action: To support Zambian government’s efforts in promoting diversification for climate resilience by contributing to efforts to draw on and use diverse knowledge in the evidence-base to inform systems-based policy making processes2. One Health – To facilitate evidence-based enhancement of national capacity and capability to deal with One Health3. Policy Coherence: To support Zambian policy coherence efforts by contributing to clarity and shared understanding on the status, progress, and interlinkages between Zambia’s food systems policies
